expectationAuditQualification: All original expect chains, case titles/inputs and numeric literals remain equal. The raw audit enumerates calls rooted at expect including nested calls and must not be interpreted as a count of independent assertions.

dependencies.correction: The earlier chat described the red worktree as clean. Its immutable sourceBefore/sourceAfter status actually contained 59 untracked node_modules symlinks. Tracked baseline source was unchanged and full status was stable, but the whole worktree was not clean.
dependencies.limit: Focused tests use existing shared third-party dependencies. The actual candidate Vitest resolver points workspace package imports at candidate paths; this is a resolver check, not a full runtime module-resolution trace. Clean integration/native validation remains separate.

remainingEvidence: Parent will integrate after review, run these same 9 files under a real frozen dependency installation, then bind the final candidate and rerun complete native CI. This record does not rewrite f0 native failures or claim clean-candidate/native acceptance.
